## Definition of Done checklist

- [ ] Consistent with the [Authoring Brief](../docs/_meta/authoring-brief.md) (or an ADR is included)
- [ ] Docs updated / metadata block + Change Log updated
- [ ] **Child safety** considered — no new risk to a child, or Trust & Safety reviewed
- [ ] **Privacy** — no unnecessary child data collected/exposed
- [ ] **Accessibility** — WCAG 2.2 AA, RTL/Urdu-first (for UI changes)
- [ ] **Low-bandwidth budget** met (for UI/media changes)
- [ ] Tests added/updated and green; CI passing
- [ ] Cross-references / links valid
